notes.note: Fix-round review for #3701 at 6d5dae66062: changes are confined to bounded stable retirement, cooldown and generation-lifetime comments; authorization/admission and the worker bytes are unchanged from base 777d9502ad8. Updated the persistence paragraph to describe stable retirement, the five-second retirement/close bound, rejection containment and the one-second cooldown. One second caps repeated worker startup/migration/WAL setup at one attempt per second per history while preserving next-poll recovery; it does not remove main-thread SQLite contention. EXECUTED: focused room-history suite 75/75; each of five new tests failed for its intended behavior when only its production safeguard was removed, then restored green. F1 observed premature Worker construction; F2 observed stale-retirement construction; F3 timeout observed an unresolved read beyond the budget; F3 rejection observed unavailable instead of recovery; F4 observed polls waiting during cooldown. NOT_VERIFIED: live-HOME HTTP contention, hosted, provider and device outcomes.
